## Context

`docs/architecture.md` describes RP-05 as pending. The module docstring in `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py` still calls the registry shadow scaffolding. The closed grapy-cynical-copepod epic and pettish-snippy-rasbora record the completed registry cutover. ADR 0100 remains the historical decision record.

## Plan

- Describe `ROUTES`, lazy handler and parser references, runtime registry dispatch, generated help inputs, and `CAPABILITIES` as the implemented boundary.
- Remove migration-pending wording from current architecture documentation.
- Correct the stale registry module docstring without changing executable behavior.
- Preserve ADR 0100 and generated-source ownership.
- Run focused registry, help coverage, help generation, and import-isolation checks.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Architecture documentation identifies RP-05 as implemented.
- [ ] Architecture documentation describes `ROUTES`.
- [ ] Architecture documentation describes lazy handler and parser references.
- [ ] Architecture documentation describes runtime registry dispatch.
- [ ] Architecture documentation describes registry-owned generated help inputs.
- [ ] Architecture documentation describes `CAPABILITIES`.
- [ ] The registry module docstring describes the implemented authority without shadow-scaffolding language.
- [ ] ADR 0100 remains unchanged.
- [ ] Executable registry behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py tests/unit/test_cli_registry_dispatch.py tests/unit/test_cli_registry_cutover_s6.py tests/unit/test_cli_registry_cutover_s6_heldout.py tests/unit/test_cli_registry_full_extra.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_cli_registry_distribution.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_help_overview_coverage.py tests/unit/test_gen_cli_help.py -q` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check` passes.
- [ ] `make import-walk` passes.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` passes.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.
